hero.title: Your refuge in the heart of Alentejo
hero.subtitle: Chalé do Avô Bedi — a wooden home with garden. The bathroom is in the courtyard, 5 metres from the living room, following feng shui tradition. Minutes from the historic centre and famous Arraiolos rugs — ideal for couples, families or group getaways.

about.title: Alentejo tradition, modern comfort
about.p1: Chalé do Avô Bedi, a wooden home, was restored with respect for local architecture, keeping its rustic charm while adding every comfort for a relaxed holiday. The bathroom is in the courtyard, 5 metres from the living room, following feng shui tradition (outside the rental unit). The living room with fireplace and fully equipped kitchen invite you to live at Alentejo pace. The garden has the Fonte dos Pés Felizes and a 4-metre-high viewpoint in a tree house.
about.pGarden: The Fonte dos Pés Felizes is a small stone basin where guests like to soak their feet at the end of the day. The lookout is the deck of the tree house, with views over the garden and the starry sky.
about.p2: Arraiolos is about 1 hour from Lisbon. Stroll to the castle, visit tapestry studios and taste regional wines — all minutes from home.
about.photoChalet: Chalé do Avô Bedi in Alentejo, surrounded by greenery
about.photoGarden: Courtyard at dusk, bench, lanterns, swing and garden lights

alexandra.quote: We loved the authenticity, and Cristina Alberto is a five-star host. The Alentejo lunch was delightful and the guided walk was genuinely breathtaking. We left feeling we had made the most of every moment.
alexandra.author: Alexandra Sousa

host.name: Cristina Alberto
host.bio: Hello, I'm Cristina Alberto. Retired university professor, PhD in Virtual Reality from UCL London, founder of Rotaract Estarreja. I returned to Arraiolos, my grandparents' land, to welcome those who want to slow down.
host.photoAlt: Cristina Alberto, host of Chalé do Avô Bedi
